# Pediatric Anxiety Research Center (PARC)

> PARC is a leading Rhode Island-based research and treatment center specializing in evidence-based care for childhood anxiety disorders and OCD through intensive programs, clinical trials, and therapist training.

Located in East Providence, RI, PARC combines clinical treatment with research initiatives, offering intensive partial hospitalization programs, outpatient therapy, and telehealth services. The center also trains community therapists in evidence-based approaches like cognitive-behavioral therapy and exposure therapy.

## Key Topics

- Pediatric Anxiety Research Center (PARC)
- Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT)
- Exposure Therapy

## Treatment Programs

- [Intensive Program for Anxiety and OCD](https://www.parcanxiety.org/intensiveprogram): PARC intensive partial hospitalization program for anxiety and OCD in East Providence.
- [Disorders We Treat](https://www.parcanxiety.org/disorders-we-treat): PARC treatment specialties: anxiety disorders, OCD, panic, agoraphobia, and related conditions.
- [Exposure Therapy](https://www.parcanxiety.org/exposuretherapy): PARC exposure therapy and CBT approach for pediatric anxiety treatment.
- [Anxiety and OCD Overview](https://www.parcanxiety.org/remove): PARC overview of anxiety disorders and OCD in youth: GAD, separation anxiety, social anxiety.
- [Program Impact & Outcomes](https://www.parcanxiety.org/ourimpact): PARC intensive anxiety/OCD program outcomes and patient success stories.

## Clinical Research Studies

- [Current Research Studies](https://www.parcanxiety.org/currentresearchstudies): PARC current research studies: IMPACT-RI, NExT, TMS, and exposure therapy trials.
- [IMPACT-RI Study](https://www.parcanxiety.org/impact-ri): IMPACT-RI: PARC clinical study on anxiety/OCD treatment via telehealth delivery.
- [NExT Study](https://www.parcanxiety.org/next-study): NExT Study: PARC clinical trial combining TMS and exposure therapy for youth OCD.
- [Past Research Studies](https://www.parcanxiety.org/pastresearchstudies): PARC past research studies and clinical trials in pediatric anxiety and OCD.

## Therapist Training & Professional Development

- [Training Services](https://www.parcanxiety.org/trainingservices): PARC training workshops and consultation for community therapists in CBT and exposure therapy.
- [Training Partnerships](https://www.parcanxiety.org/trainingpartners): PARC training partnerships with organizations like Blue Cross Blue Shield Rhode Island.
